title: Horizon chunked embed bulk import with multi-scope idempotency
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a production-ready bulk embeddings ingest path that supports streaming uploads, chunked/batched processing, asynchronous job lifecycle, robust retry semantics, and explicit idempotency at multiple scopes (client-global and per-chunk). This ticket scopes API, orchestration, storage, DB schema, observability, and rollout for the initial MVP of the feature (server-side batching + async job API) and a follow-up for client-side SDK helpers.
acceptance_criteria: Public REST API: /v1/embeddings:bulk that accepts a multipart/chunk manifest or an upload URL and returns job_id immediately
Clients can supply an idempotency key for the whole job AND optional per-chunk idempotency keys; duplicate submissions must be deduplicated
System persists minimal job metadata and checkpoints so jobs can resume after transient failures without reprocessing verified successful chunks
Job has observable state transitions (queued -> ingesting -> processing -> completed | failed) surfaced in Console and via /v1/embeddings/jobs/{job_id}
Throughput target: 200k vectors/hour per logical job on dedicated pool, with linear scaling across worker fleet
End-to-end test harness demonstrates at-least-once delivery for chunks with deduplication to one final embedding row per source id
Retry/backpressure behavior documented: client retry window, TTL for idempotency keys, error codes for non-idempotent conflicts
implementation_notes: API accepts 1) manifest JSON with object URLs (S3/GCS) or 2) chunked multipart streaming POSTs; server validates manifest and enqueues async job
Storage: prefer presigned object upload to S3-compatible blob store for large payloads; small payloads (<1MB) allowed inline as ndjson array
Orchestration: worker pool using k8s Job workers with a distributed lease/queue (Redis Stream or internal queue) for chunk processing
Checkpoint model: per-job sequence checkpoint (horizon) plus per-chunk status rows; minimal in-memory cache for hot jobs, durable state in jobs table
Idempotency: two-scope keys: job_idempotency_key (client opaque) and chunk_idempotency_key; TTL for keys 7 days by default; conflicts return 409 with canonical job_id
Deduplication: chunk SHA256 + chunk_idempotency_key used to detect duplicate uploads across retries and idempotency windows
Backpressure: rate limiter per-customer and per-job with 429 + Retry-After; autoscaler hints emitted to Dedicated pool for burst capacity
KV and cache considerations: avoid storing raw embeddings in the jobs table; workers stream vectors into the embed-writes pipeline (append-only sink) with idempotent write tokens
Observability: emit job.progress, chunk.success, chunk.failure, dups_detected, and per-token cost estimate metrics to Console
api_contract: POST /v1/embeddings/bulk -> { job_id, status_url, submitted_at }. Body options: {manifest_url, inline_chunks:[{chunk_id, objects:[{id, text}], idempotency_key}], job_idempotency_key}. GET /v1/embeddings/jobs/{job_id} returns job state, progress, chunk statuses. DELETE cancels queued jobs. 429 for rate limits, 409 for idempotency conflict with existing job_id returned.
data_model_changes: jobs table: job_id PK, customer_id, job_idempotency_key (unique per customer), state, created_at, updated_at, progress_pct, error_summary
chunks table: chunk_id PK, job_id FK, chunk_idempotency_key, sha256, status(enum), attempts, last_error, processed_at
embed_write_tokens: transient tokens used by writers to do idempotent final writes to vector table
TTL indices: idempotency keys TTL 7d, job retention default 30d (configurable per-customer)
runbook_and_monitoring: Console dashboard: Jobs-in-flight, avg chunk latency, chunk failure rate, dup rate, time-to-complete distribution
SLOs: 95% of jobs <= 10 minutes for <=10k records, 99% of chunks processed within 30s under normal load
Alert: chunk_failure_rate > 5% sustained over 10m for a single customer -> page oncall infra
Playbook: steps to restart workers, clear stuck leases, re-enqueue failed chunks, and invalidate idempotency keys when appropriate
testing_plan: Unit tests for idempotency detection logic (job- and chunk-scope)
Integration test: manifest upload -> worker processing -> vectors visible in embeddings table with one-to-one dedupe
Chaos test: kill random workers mid-job and verify resume semantics by requeuing remaining chunks
Load test: simulate 10k concurrent clients submitting 100-chunk jobs to validate autoscaler and queueing behavior
E2E QA with real model: verify cost estimates, token accounting, and quality parity vs single-shot ingestion
rollout_plan: Soft launch to internal orgs and a limited beta list (10 customers) for 2 weeks
Enable feature flag per-customer; default off for newly provisioned customers until 1st GA
Collect metrics and watch for dup/miscount incidents; iterate on dedupe thresholds and TTLs
Gradual ramp to GA with capacity reservations and Dedicated autoscale policy updates
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: duplicate vectors due to race window on idempotency TTL. Mitigation: chunk-level SHA verification + eventual dedupe cleanup job
Risk: transient storage loss of manifest objects. Mitigation: require object size + checksum at upload time, provide reupload flow
Risk: runaway costs from misconfigured client looping. Mitigation: strong per-customer quotas, early rejection with billing warning, and disable-by-default on new accounts
Risk: data consistency across region failover. Mitigation: single-region job orchestration for job lifetime with cross-region fallback policy for reads

comments: 2025-01-15 Aisha Patel: Triage notes - customer requests for large-scale embedding imports continue to surface. Spike proposal to support manifest + chunked streaming. Assigned to Marco.

2025-01-20 Marco Ruiz: Spike done. Verified S3 presigned + manifest flow + naive worker processed 50k vectors in 6m on dev cluster. Observed hotspots in DB writes; need idempotent write tokens to avoid duplicate writes under retries.
2025-01-22 Priya Shah (PM): Design review feedback - add explicit job-level idempotency and expose job progress URL in SDK. Also require retention config per-customer for idempotency TTL.
2025-01-27 Design review: UX suggestions to show per-chunk failure reason and a 'retry failed chunks' button in Console. Added design doc link above.
2025-01-30 Marco Ruiz: Implementation started. Created jobs/chunks tables migration. Working on chunk ingestion handler; choosing Redis streams for queue initially for lower latency than SQS.
2025-02-03 Security review kickoff: request for threat model for presigned upload flows and checks for object spoofing. Marked security_review_required=true
2025-02-05 Marco Ruiz: Initial e2e integration tests passing on staging for inline_chunks flow. Manifest + presigned object flow pending. Will start limited internal beta next week.
